enums.name: ToolInputTransport
enums.description: Closed ways bounded job input reaches a worker. The browser chooses from the declared length; a worker opens nothing itself.

members.name: INLINE
members.description: The bytes ride inside the argument record, bounded by MAX_INLINE_PAYLOAD_BYTES.

members.name: SHARED_MEMORY
members.description: The bytes arrive as one browser-mapped read-only region attached to the job, and the argument record carries none.

enums.name: ToolOutputTransport
enums.description: Closed ways bounded job output leaves a worker, decided by the browser before the job starts.

members.name: INLINE_CHUNKS
members.description: Ordered chunks the browser buffers until the terminal completion; the historic shape.

members.name: STREAM_CHUNKS
members.description: Ordered chunks forwarded as each one arrives, ending at the chunk that marks itself final.

members.name: DATA_PIPE
members.description: Bulk bytes through one browser-held pipe; the chunk stream then carries no bytes of its own.

structs.name: OperationEnvelope
structs.description: Identity and recovery metadata shared with the core-service contract.

fields.name: service_generation
fields.description: Profile core generation used to reject stale jobs.

fields.name: deadline_monotonic_ms
fields.description: Absolute wall deadline enforced by the broker.

structs.name: ResourceBudget
structs.description: Hard per-job limits enforced outside the worker and checked inside it.

fields.name: max_output_bytes
fields.description: Maximum returned output bytes across chunks and the terminal body.

fields.name: max_memory_bytes
fields.description: Maximum resident memory attributed to the job.

fields.name: max_output_chunks
fields.description: Maximum number of streamed output chunks.

structs.name: ToolModelArtifact
structs.description: The registered on-device model the browser resolved and opened for this job. The record names the artifact; the opened resource itself is attached beside the job, so a worker can neither choose an artifact nor look one up.

fields.name: model_id
fields.description: Registered model identity the browser resolved against its own register; never a path.

fields.name: model_revision
fields.description: Pinned revision of that registered model.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Closed artifact format the worker must load the attached resource as.

fields.name: artifact_bytes
fields.description: Exact length of the attached artifact, bounded by MAX_MODEL_ARTIFACT_BYTES.

fields.name: artifact_digest
fields.description: SHA-256 of the attached artifact, so a worker refuses a resource that is not the one this record declares.

fields.name: adapter_id
fields.description: Registered adapter identity, or empty when the job runs the base model alone.

fields.name: adapter_bytes
fields.description: Exact length of the attached adapter, or zero when there is none.

fields.name: adapter_digest
fields.description: SHA-256 of the attached adapter, or thirty-two zero bytes when there is none.

structs.name: ToolPythonLibrary
structs.description: The bundled Python standard library the browser resolved and opened for this job. An interpreter that starts with an empty import path and no archive imports nothing at all, so this is the record that makes a Python job able to run rather than an extra it may do without. It names and measures the archive; the opened read-only descriptor travels beside the job, because a worker whose process denies it the filesystem could not check a path and must never be handed one. Every field is empty or zero when no library was resolved, which is the only shape the runtimes that do not run an interpreter ever carry.

fields.name: library_id
fields.description: Registered bundled library identity the browser resolved against its own register, or empty when this job runs no interpreter; never a path.

fields.name: library_version
fields.description: Pinned version of that registered library, or empty when there is none.

fields.name: archive_bytes
fields.description: Exact length of the attached archive, bounded by MAX_PYTHON_LIBRARY_BYTES, or zero when there is none.

fields.name: archive_digest
fields.description: SHA-256 of the attached archive, so a worker refuses a resource that is not the one this record declares, or thirty-two zero bytes when there is none.

structs.name: ToolPayloadInput
structs.description: How this job's bounded input reaches the worker, and what it must measure once it arrives.

fields.name: transport
fields.description: Closed input transport the browser chose from the declared length.

fields.name: byte_length
fields.description: Exact input length, whichever transport carries it, never above the job budget.

fields.name: digest
fields.description: SHA-256 of the input bytes, or thirty-two zero bytes when the length is zero.

structs.name: ToolPayloadOutput
structs.description: How this job's bounded output leaves the worker. A worker never selects its own transport, because the transport decides what the browser has to hold.

fields.name: transport
fields.description: Closed output transport chosen by the browser before the job starts.

fields.name: max_byte_length
fields.description: Hard total output length across every transport, never above the job budget.

structs.name: BundledPythonArguments
structs.description: Arguments for one reviewed bundled pure-Python entrypoint.

fields.name: entrypoint_id
fields.description: Allowlisted entrypoint inside the bundled module.

fields.name: input
fields.description: Bounded module input validated against the registered tool descriptor.

structs.name: LocalModelArguments
structs.description: Arguments for one bounded disposable local-model conversation.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.description: Opaque conversation identity partitioned to one profile generation.

fields.name: max_output_tokens
fields.description: Hard output-token limit checked by the broker and worker.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The registered artifact the browser opened for this conversation.

structs.name: LocalEmbeddingArguments
structs.description: Arguments for one bounded embedding of validated text. Pooling belongs to the registered model rather than to the caller, so there is no field for it.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The registered embedding artifact the browser opened.

fields.name: max_input_tokens
fields.description: Hard input-token limit checked by the broker and the worker.

fields.name: normalize
fields.description: Whether the worker returns the unit-length vector.

structs.name: MediaProbeArguments
structs.description: Arguments for metadata inspection of one broker-owned input.

fields.name: input_handle
fields.description: Opaque broker-owned read handle; never an ambient path.

structs.name: AudioExtractArguments
structs.description: Arguments for one approved audio extraction preset.

structs.name: FrameSampleArguments
structs.description: Arguments for bounded frame sampling.

fields.name: max_frames
fields.description: Hard maximum number of produced frames.

structs.name: TranscodeArguments
structs.description: Arguments for one approved transcode preset.

structs.name: SignedWasmArguments
structs.description: Reserved arguments for one reviewed signed transform.

fields.name: entrypoint_id
fields.description: Allowlisted entrypoint in the signed bundled transform.

structs.name: ToolJob
structs.description: A registered bounded job with exactly one typed body and no ambient authority.

fields.name: job_id
fields.description: Opaque job identity unique within the operation.

fields.name: runtime
fields.description: Compile-time runtime family selected and checked by the browser broker.

fields.name: input_payload
fields.description: How this job's bounded input reaches the worker.

fields.name: output_payload
fields.description: How this job's bounded output leaves the worker.

fields.name: python_library
fields.description: The standard library this job's interpreter is to import from. It is present on every job rather than only on Python ones, and carries an empty identity and a zero digest wherever no interpreter runs, because the browser decides what a worker receives and a field a sender may omit is a field a sender may forget.

structs.name: ToolProgress
structs.description: A bounded content-free progress event.

fields.name: progress_basis_points
fields.description: Progress from zero through ten thousand.

structs.name: TextOutputChunk
structs.description: One bounded UTF-8 output chunk.

fields.name: utf8
fields.description: UTF-8 bytes validated before crossing the browser boundary.

structs.name: BinaryOutputChunk
structs.description: One bounded binary output chunk.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Binary output validated against the registered tool descriptor.

structs.name: ToolOutputChunk
structs.description: A bounded ordered chunk with exactly one representation.

fields.name: is_final
fields.description: True on the last chunk of a streamed output, so a reader knows the stream ended without waiting for the terminal completion.

structs.name: ToolAdmission
structs.description: Immediate job admission without implying worker completion.

structs.name: BundledPythonResult
structs.description: Validated terminal output from one bundled Python entrypoint.

fields.name: output
fields.description: Bounded output validated against the registered tool descriptor.

structs.name: LocalModelResult
structs.description: Content-free local-model terminal metadata; text arrives through ordered chunks.

structs.name: LocalEmbeddingResult
structs.description: One bounded embedding vector. The elements are carried as declared bytes rather than as floats: this wire is positional and frozen, the same vector has to compare equal on two devices, and a float has neither one bit pattern per value nor a total order.

fields.name: dimensions
fields.description: Vector length in elements, bounded by MAX_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.

fields.name: element_kind
fields.description: Closed element encoding, which fixes the width and the byte order.

fields.name: values
fields.description: The vector itself: exactly dimensions elements in the declared encoding, bounded by MAX_EMBEDDING_VALUE_BYTES.

structs.name: MediaProbeResult
structs.description: Bounded media metadata with no codec or container-controlled strings.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Validated maximum video width or zero.

fields.name: height
fields.description: Validated maximum video height or zero.

structs.name: AudioExtractResult
structs.description: Terminal metadata for an audio extraction written to a broker-owned output.

fields.name: output_digest
fields.description: Exact 32-byte SHA-256 of the completed broker-owned output.

structs.name: FrameSampleResult
structs.description: Terminal metadata for bounded frame sampling.

fields.name: output_digest
fields.description: Exact 32-byte SHA-256 of the completed broker-owned frame archive.

structs.name: TranscodeResult
structs.description: Terminal metadata for one approved transcode preset.

fields.name: output_digest
fields.description: Exact 32-byte SHA-256 of the completed broker-owned output.

structs.name: SignedWasmResult
structs.description: Validated terminal output from one reviewed signed transform.

structs.name: ToolSuccess
structs.description: Exactly one typed success body matching the submitted operation.

structs.name: ToolCompletion
structs.description: Exactly one terminal completion; success is present only for COMPLETED.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Validated typed output present only for COMPLETED.
